title: Safecreeper
description: Creeperblockguard prevents Creepers from destroying blocks while still allowing explosions to damage entities. Protect your builds without losing the thrill of explosions!
body:
Protect your builds from Creeper chaos!

CreeperBlockGuard prevents Creepers from destroying blocks while still allowing explosions to damage mobs and players. Finally, you can enjoy the thrill of explosions without losing your carefully crafted structures.

Features:

Creeper explosions no longer break blocks

TNT and other explosions behave normally

Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge

Works on both servers and single-player

Installation:

Download the .jar file.

Place it in your mods folder.

Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.20.1.

Enjoy explosion fun without the destruction!

Notes:

Can be installed on servers or client + server. Clients don’t need the mod for server-side protection.

Perfect for survival, adventure maps, or creative builds.
